# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_arp_table (Data Source)

Use the `cloud_router_arp_table` data source to list ARP entries for a cloud router VRF

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_arp_table" "example" {
  vrf = "vrf-123"
}

output "arp_table" {
  value = data.ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_arp_table.example.arp_entries
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `arp_entries` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--arp_entries))
- `network_service_config` (String) Filter by network service config ID
- `vrf` (String) Filter by VRF ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--arp_entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `arp_entries`

Optional:

- `device_fqdn` (String) FQDN of the device reporting this ARP entry
- `expiration_time` (Number) Expiration time in seconds
- `ip_address` (String) IP address of the ARP entry
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the ARP entry
- `network_service_config` (String) Network service config ID
- `received_at` (String) Timestamp when the ARP entry was received
- `vrf` (String) VRF ID
